review:
The 2019 original that started one of Pragmatic's longest series: 20 lines, cartoon dogs and a kennel wild. Wilds only land on reels 2, 3 and 4, each with a multiplier, so a line through two or three of them can pay far above normal.

The free spins are what made it famous: every wild sticks for the rest of the round, so a few early wilds set up multiplied wins on every remaining spin. 96.51% RTP. Simple and readable.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
